Lucia.how: joins after the strategy battle of Brass Castle.

Fred.how: he joins either at Duck Village or Chisha Village, depending on if you tell him your mission.

Viki.how: In Chapter 4, go up the Mountain Path to Caleria. There, Viki will fall from the sky. Recruit her then.

Aila.how: In Karaya Village, Ace and Joker will see her argue with a woman and go chase her. Pursue them, and when Karaya is attacked, Aila will join with Ace and Joker. After you meet Geddoe and Queen again, Aila will join permanently. This is all automatic.

Lilly.how: she joins with Hugo temporarily, and then leaves during his Chapter 3. She returns again, permanently, in Chapter 4, and that too is automatic.

Reed.how: joins with Lilly both temporarily and permanent

Samus.how: he joins with Lilly both temporarily and permanent

Duke.how: you must not abandon the Le Buque villagers until Duke gets there.

Futch.how: He’s on the Mountain Path close to Caleria. Offer to help him and he’ll take you to Caleria. Find the girl he’s looking for, and then talk to Futch outside the gates. He’ll join you.

Shiba.how: Joins briefly in Geddoe Chapter 1, but leaves quickly. Joins in Chapter 4 permanently with Lucia.

Sasarai.how: he joins after the first strategy battle in Chapter 5

Franz.how: do not abandon the villagers in Le Buque. He joins after Duke.

Ayame.how: Talk to Watari in Budehec Castle to see a scene about him and a female ninja named Ayame. Then, go to North Cavern’s treasure boss room with Watari in the party, and Ayame will be there. Duel her, and if you win, she joins. If you lose, she’ll disappear and you can try again later.

Watari.how: Give him 100,000 potch. He’s in Iksay village, hidden behind a house.

Melville.how: In Hugo Chapter 1, watch him argue with Guilliame. After that, enter the alleyway, climb up the scaffolding, and knock on the window, answering “Saint Loa Knights” when the voice talks. After the scene plays through, you’ll have Melville temporarily. To recruit Melville permanently, recruit Billy, then wait to Chapter 4, and then talk to Melville in the alleyway where his clubhouse was.

Alanis.how: Temporarily in Hugo Chapter 1, you recruit her as you recruit Melville. To recruit her permanently, wait until Chapter 4, and then talk to her in Great Hollow with Melville and Elliott in the party.

Rhett.how: and no. Rhett and Wilder are recruited as guides to Chisha by Chris in her chapter 3, and they must join. After the strategy battle at Chisha, the two ducks will leave. To recruit them permanently, wait until Chapter 4, then talk to them with Sgt. Joe in the party. They will be in Duck Village

Nash.how: joins in Iksay, leaves briefly, then joins again at Brass Castle. He’s unplayable for the later part of the game, but he will rejoin when Sasarai joins the Fire Bringer.

Belle.how: Talk to her in Brass Castle, and she’ll ask for a screw. Find one fighting the white rabbits with the hatchets in the Plains of Amur, and then give it to her.

Mel.how: Talk to her in Iksay Village and offer to show her Budehec.

Koroku.how: adopt him in Mt. Hei-to. Take the first fork up and then go left. He’s in the grass to the left of the body.

Yuiri.how: She joins for two boss battles in Chris’s Chapter 3 (and only the battles), then she joins permanently with Yumi in Chapter 5.

Yumi.how: Yumi will join temporarily to bring Chris to Alma Kinan. After you leave Alma Kinan, Yumi leaves the party. She’ll return permanently after Chris is ambushed and attacked, and you reach the first strategy battle of Chapter 5.

Jimba.how: joins with Lucia, unless Hugo is the Flame Champion, when he joins when Hugo returns to Chisha Village.

Luc.how: You must recruit all 104 Stars of Destiny before the strategy battle at the Ceremonial Site (after Nash returns). After defeating the final boss, a new section will appear on the Trinity Sight. Once it is selected, Luc becomes the main character.

Nei.how: Go to Vinay del Zexay and watch Guilliame chase Shabon. Then, talk to Nei and Toppo in the city and ask about her. Then, go to the Zexen Council Hall where Guilliame will be chasing Shabon. Duel Guilliame and win, and then Nei and her band will join you.

Kenji.how: Find him in the Northern Plains, and talk to him. After you exercise, ask for water.

Twaikin.how: talk to him in Great Hollow, and then lie him out of a jam. Offer him a job to expand Budehec.

Augustine.how: Talk to Augustine in Vinay del Zexay (he is by the ocean). Buy a Rose Brooch in the item shop in Iksay Village. Return it to him.

Landis.how: in the Kuput Forest, have an empty space. Run around and fight monsters until you find him in your party. You must stand in a certain spot to recruit him. From the west entrance to the forest, continue until you reach a path split. It is inside this split where Landis can be recruited.

Sanae Y.how: After you have recruited 50 Stars of Destiny, find her in the back of Duck Village. Settle her dispute by telling her “You should thank him from your heart”. Then, offer to have her help you.

Viki (Young).how: Once you recruit Viki (Big), put her in your party and go to the Mountain Path where you met Viki (Big) before. After the scene plays, Viki (Little) will join and give you a unique item called the Blinking Mirror, which returns you to Budehec Castle from anywhere on the World Map.

Edge.how: Give him 1000 potch, and them beat him in a duel. He is outside of the Le Buque magic shop

Wan Fu.how: Talk to him in Chisha, and then give him 3000 potch to cover his debt. He’ll join you.

Estella.how: Talk to Rody outside of Alma Kinan’s inn. Then, go inside the inn and talk to Estella. She says she’ll join your party if you find Gordius Village, the all-male counterpart of Alma Kinan. Go to the clearing where Yun sacrificed herself, and talk to the girl there. She will say there is no such thing. Return to Estella, and she and Rody will join your party.

Emily.how: beat her in an arm wrestling match. Between the group of your characters, you need to have a strength of at least 600 to win.

Shizu.how: She will fix the elevator in Thomas’s chapter.

Mamie.how: She is in Duck Village. Give her a Crab Rice Bowl (you can fight Mantikras in the Zexen or Kuput Forest for them, and Hallec starts with one equipped). Then, she’ll join.

Gordon.how: if you are playing as Chris, then talk to him with a full party (5 others). If you are anyone else, then you talk to him with a party of only males. He is the owner of Iksay’s item store.

Dominic.how: purchase his Mole Armor at his shop in Vinay del Zexay. After that, offer him a job.

Jeane.how: Offer her a job at Budehec. She is in Brass Castle’s Rune Shop.

Peggi.how: give her one of the new hammers. The Iron Hammer is held by a Chishan man in the Great Hollow Trading Post, the Copper Hammer is held by a Calerian stand-owner (not obtainable until chapter 3). The Silver Hammer is held by an Alma Kinan woman in Duck Village's Tutor (not obtainable until Chapter 4.) and the Golden Hammer is a rare find in Iksay's item shop in Chapter 5.

Scott.how: Bring him a Deer Antler. They can be found in Vinay del Zexay’s trade shop.

Hortez.how: Talk to him in Duck Village and tell him how to get to Budehec. Then, go to Chisha and tell him how to get there. Next, go to Caleria and talk to him a third time. He’ll be back at Duck Village. When you talk to him again, lie about the location, and Hortez will finally make it there.

Ernie.how: Talk to her in Brass Castle’s Tutor shop, and answer her five questions.

Billy.how: Place an “S” rank statue in the statue room, leave, and then re-enter. Beat Billy at cards to recruit him.

Elliot.how: he is recruited, both temporarily and permanently, the same style as Melville.

Kidd.how: you must solve “The Duck Clan Murder Case”. Talk to the various ducks around Duck Village to gain clues, interrogate the suspects and search the crime scene. When you’ve done it all, return to Kidd and the case will be solved. Offer him a job at Budehec afterwards.

Mike.how: Win 15000 potch in his card game of Kabu (it’s kind of like baccarat) He’ll join afterwards. Mike is in the Caleria trade shop.

Jefferson.how: Once you recruit 70 Stars of Destiny, he will be at Budehec’s gates. Go to him, and he joins automatically.

Kathy.how: Go to the Plains of Amur – North, and she will be there with her horses. Count the amount of horses, and then when she asks, tell her how many there are. Offer her a job at Budehec Castle afterwards. If you make a mistake, she’ll leave and come back later.

Goro.how: Talk to him in the Zexen Forest, while he is looking at trees. If you have someone with the Appraisal skill, you can help him find what he needs to build a bath. Then, offer him a job at Budehec.

Arthur.how: Talk to him in Brass Castle’s mess hall, then look at the cooking stove that Hugo and company fell through in his Chapter 1. Go towards the end of the tunnel, and at the end, Arthur will join.

Nadir.how: Talk to him in Caleria, upstairs in the inn. If you have a party of three men, two women, and one child, he will join your party.

Barts.how: Bring him a Grape (Grapes can be purchased cheap in Chisha Village. Barts is in Iksay).

Tuta.how: First, recruit Mio. Then, wait till Chapter 4 and go to Chisha Village with Mio in support. Find Tuta in the room where Hugo was resting after his defeat by Yuber.

Mio.how: Talk to her in Iksay Village’s upstairs room in the inn.
